messages:
Maya - Marketing: Quick sync  we need a visual taxonomy for the benchmark publish + webinar next week. Assets: hero image, explainer GIF (how batching/kv-cache works), speaker slide deck (10 slides), and a downloadable A4 one-pager. Can Leo take lead on visuals?
Ravi - Content: I'll write the narrative + 3-callout bullets for hero. Also will draft the GIF script: short frames showing request -> caching -> lower cost.
Leo - Design: I can own visuals. Questions: GIF frame count and final export sizes? Also do we want animated charts or simplified icons to avoid clutter?
Noah - Growth: GIF should be native for socials (MP4 + GIF fallback). Sizes: hero 1200x675 for socials, webinar slide 16:9 (1920x1080). One-pager A4 PDF (300dpi). For CTAs: need two short lines for social: "Save on LLM inference" (21), "Serve faster, pay less" (19).
Maya - Marketing: good. GIF: 69 frames max (3s). Use simplified icons + a single chart morph for the cost drop. Export MP4 (H264), GIF, and an APNG for high-res.
BrandBot: Brand update v2.4 applied 4bb 4dd 10: Please use primary #0B5FFF and accent #00C48C; small logo for <640px. Brand grid and accessible color pairs: https://redwood/brand/grid.
Ravi - Content: I'll attach the methodology snippet: test workload (assistant prompts), models (open variants), batch sizes (1,8,32), quant levels (fp16,int8). Will include the appendix table with raw numbers and standard deviation.
Leo - Design: noted. I'll mock 3 GIF storyboards tonight in Figma and add a simplified chart for the morph. If we need absolute tables, we'll put them on the one-pager appendix so the hero stays simple.
Noah - Growth: Webinar sign-up form needs these mapping fields: email, company, role, monthly inference spend (dropdown), primary use-case (dropdown). If monthly spend > $2000 route to AE. Also add a hidden utm_source for social campaign. Form id: 7890.
Ivy - Legal: reminder 6a7 any comparative claims must have footnoted source. If you say "up to 40% lower" include (1) the test config and (2) the dataset. Send methodology + CSV to legal for review.
Maya - Marketing: timeline: GIF + hero draft by Thurs 3pm; slides draft by Thurs EOD; one-pager draft by Fri noon. Legal sign-off by Mon 9am. Leo/Ravi—please tag me in Figma comments.
Leo - Design: will upload Figma link: https://figma.com/file/ef56bench/gifs-visuals tonight and add export presets.
Ravi - Content: uploading CSV and methodology to the Figma thread: https://s3.redwood/benchmarks/webinar-data.csv. Ivy, sending you the doc now.
Noah - Growth: I'll prepare the HubSpot mapping and Slack alert routing (Sales vs Marketing) once form fields are final.
Ivy - Legal: got it. Will review once I have CSV + methodology; plan for 24h turnaround.
Maya - Marketing: small brand ask: avoid competitor logos and use neutral labels (Vendor X). Also include alt text strings for all assets for accessibility.
Leo - Design: noted on neutral labels + alt text. Will include color-contrast checks and export an accessibility text file with alt strings.
Maya - Marketing: great. Final ask: can we also produce a square version of the hero for IG (1080x1080) and a vertical 1080x1920 for stories? Add to the export list.
Leo - Design: adding square and vertical. Will post proofs to #marketing-review by Fri 10am PST.
Noah - Growth: I'll share CTA copy variants in the Figma comments and confirm the form id mapping by Fri noon.
Maya - Marketing: perfect. If anything blocks, DM me. Thanks everyone!
